reason: A midpoint of an asymmetric lowered/raised range can sit above the shoulders and reject an actual chest-height front hold.
reproduction: Three tests (left/right/both) actually prepare accepted in-frame samples with shoulders y280, asymmetric lowered wrist y334 and raised wrist y28; then front wrist y298 has tracking ready but holding=false before fix.
fix: Standard front proxy uses abs(wristY-0.15)<=hold ratio in shoulder-width units, with distance from both observed endpoints greater than minPoseSeparation. Lateral/bend/quality/raw+smooth/confirmation/gap gates retained.
newNegatives: Bent-elbow lowered or raised endpoints still cannot count even when inside the standard shoulder band.
testMigration: New leniency hysteresis test now chooses shoulder-space drift between enter/exit bands, retaining warm-hold/cold-no-start and endpoint release assertions.
results: 3 targeted RED failures, then 227/227 related unit tests pass.
